_help: EXTRA LLM models for the dashboard picker. Paste NVIDIA NIM model ids fetched from https://build.nvidia.com (or GET <NVIDIA_NIM_BASE_URL>/models) into the 'nvidia' list. Entries can be plain ids ("org/model-id") or objects with id/label/description/speed. This file EXTENDS the built-in catalog in llm/model_catalog.py - it is safe to leave entries here forever. Unknown shapes never crash the server (they are ignored with a log line). A {"models": {...}} wrapper is also accepted.
